$comment: Repository-root marker. scripts/lib/root.sh finds the framework root by walking up to this file. Hand-maintained.

yq.purpose: YAML reads in the always-on validation stage

jq.purpose: JSON reads, finding emission, view rendering

rg.purpose: ripgrep assertions in the complete framework maintenance gate

fd.purpose: file discovery assertions in the complete framework maintenance gate

shellcheck.purpose: warning and style analysis in the complete framework maintenance gate

check-jsonschema.purpose: optional JSON Schema stage; absent means the schema check reports not validated. Pinned: an unpinned validator means the contract is checked against whatever version resolved. Runs with --regex-variant default (ECMAScript), so contract patterns avoid lookarounds and inline flags.

skills-ref.purpose: Agent Skills reference validation from pinned official source

uv.purpose: runs the optional JSON Schema stage; CI installs this pin so the stage executes rather than skipping
